alternates.description: The block shape may consists of any amount of alternatives, one of which will be randomly chosen when the block is placed in the world

insertBakedTextures.description: Whether or not to insert baked in textures for mesh formats such as gltf into the texture atlas.

offsetX.description: How much should this shape be offset on X axis?

offsetY.description: How much should this shape be offset on Y axis?

offsetZ.description: How much should this shape be offset on Z axis?

overlays.description: The shape will render all overlays on top of this shape. Can be used to group multiple shapes into one composite shape.

quantityElements.description: If non zero will only tesselate the first n elements of the shape

rotateX.description: How much, in degrees, should this shape be rotated around the X axis?

rotateY.description: How much, in degrees, should this shape be rotated around the Y axis?

rotateZ.description: How much, in degrees, should this shape be rotated around the Z axis?

selectiveElements.description: If set will only tesselate elements with given name

voxelizeTexture.description: If true, the shape is created from a voxelized version of the first defined texture
